title: Bridging KV-Cache Quantization and Linear Attention: From Theory to Pretrained Weight Migration
abstract: arXiv:2610.11214v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: KV-cache quantization and linear attention are two representative approaches to tackling the storage and computational costs of Transformers. KV-cache quantization compresses individual KV entries into discrete codes but retains all entries, whereas linear attention recurrently aggregates multiple historical KV contributions into a fixed-size continuous state but can introduce interference. This contrast raises the question of whether per-KV compression and multi-KV aggregation can be bridged within a single mechanism for efficient attention. We identify RAM-Net as such a bridge through soft assignments over a discrete address space. These assignments determine recurrent updates to the continuous slot state associated with each address. translated_title: 弥合KV缓存量化与线性注意力：从理论到预训练权重迁移
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.11214v1 公告类型：交叉发布。摘要：KV缓存量化与线性注意力是应对Transformer存储与计算成本的两种代表性方法。KV缓存量化将单个KV条目压缩为离散编码，但仍需保留所有条目；而线性注意力则以循环方式将多个历史KV贡献聚合到一个固定大小的连续状态中，却可能引入干扰。这种对比引出了一个问题：能否在单一机制内将逐KV压缩与多KV聚合结合起来，以实现高效注意力。我们发现RAM-Net正是这样一座桥梁，它通过在离散地址空间上进行软分配来实现。这些软分配决定了对与每个地址相关联的连续槽状态的循环更新。在一个受限的RAM-Net构造下，我们证明软地址分配将硬量化匹配扩展为一种可分离的读写重叠机制，该机制能够局部逼近全注意力的相似度……
tldr: 提出RAM-Net作为统一KV缓存量化与线性注意力的桥梁，通过离散地址空间上的软分配机制，在理论上证明其可分离读写重叠能局部逼近全注意力相似度，并支持从预训练权重迁移。
en_tdlr: RAM-Net bridges KV-cache quantization and linear attention via soft assignments over a discrete address space, theoretically proven to form a separable read-write overlap that locally approximates full-attention similarity and enables migration from pretrained weights.
